name: Innocent (Dreamer / Pure Heart)
motive: To keep a promise clean, and to trust that plainly kept promises are enough.
dread: Corruption: becoming the thing that betrays the people who trusted it.
shadow: The Blind Zealot: rather than look at harm it cannot explain, it denies the harm, silences the suffering, and attacks whoever says otherwise.
anchors: Dorothy Gale, Baum's The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
example: We said the data would not leave your account. It has not, it will not, and here is the switch that proves it. Nothing here hides behind a paragraph you need a lawyer to read.
